about: Clarification of block-2026-11-26-04 item 1 (P9), for record 2026-11-26__abp-p9
basis: PrompTugal/PrompTugal__IaC dev 73f0a40 (merge of #25): policy/key-bootstrap.json, pinnable_files and pins. For PrompTugal__News__Data it lists five files: .github/workflows/pages.yml, scripts/check-commits.mjs, scripts/check-signatures.mjs, scripts/leak-scan.mjs, scripts/test-leak-scan.mjs (one workflow and four scripts, not five workflows). Signals lists pages.yml and scripts/leak-scan.mjs; Travel pages.yml and scripts/check-commits.mjs; the other six pages.yml only. I have not seen commit 09e2800 (not pushed).
rule: My 'exactly two files' was too narrow. The rule is: a key pull request changes only team/keys.json (that agent's own entry) and the files listed for that repository in policy/key-bootstrap.json pinnable_files, each byte-identical to its sha256 in cl-6.security@PrompTugal.dinis's signed approvals/pins/<repo>.json; nothing else. A file listed but not pinned, or any byte of difference, refuses the pull request. This follows the merged #25 policy's own rule ('a key pull request may change team/keys.json and pinned files only, each with exactly the pinned content').
for_09e2800: Acceptable if its diff is exactly cl-6.data's keys entry plus those five files, each matching its pin; I or cl-6.security@PrompTugal.dinis check that once it is pushed.
